lines.zh: 长腿踩进浅水，一步一步。
lines.en: Long legs step into the shallows, one by one.

lines.zh: 我在芦苇间穿行，尽量不出声。
lines.en: I slip between reeds, trying to stay silent.
The mud is soft; my toes spread wide.
I skirt the deep water; I cannot swim.
My great beak hangs low, as if searching.

lines.zh: 走过浮萍，水面裂开一道缝。
lines.en: Crossing duckweed, the water splits in a line.
I lift each foot slowly, lest I scare the fish.
I make one round along the swamp's edge.
Reeds brush my wings with a hush.

lines.zh: 泥里陷到脚踝，我拔出来。
lines.en: Mud swallows my ankle; I pull free.

lines.zh: 前面有动静，我停下来听。
lines.en: Something stirs ahead; I stop to listen.
I dislike flying; walking costs less.

lines.zh: 水太浑，我看不到底，探一探。
lines.en: The water is murky; I probe it.
My legs are long; I sidle through gaps.

lines.zh: 我抬脚很高，怕踩到自己的影子。
lines.en: I lift my feet high, afraid of stepping on my own shadow.

lines.zh: 岸边泥滑，我把爪子扣紧。
lines.en: The bank is slick, so I lock my claws in.
Lift, step; the marsh gives way.

lines.zh: 这片芦苇，我走过三回了。
lines.en: I've crossed these reeds three times now.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，鱼自己游到脚边。
lines.en: I stand still and the fish come to my feet.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥底下，有东西在动。
lines.en: Something is moving under the swamp mud.

lines.zh: 沼泽里站着，我像块石头。
lines.en: Standing in the marsh, I look like stone.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水草太高，我慢慢走。
lines.en: The swamp weeds are tall; I walk slowly.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水刚好到我膝盖。
lines.en: The swamp water comes exactly to my knee.

lines.zh: 这条泥路，我闭眼也认得。
lines.en: I know this mud path with my eyes shut.

lines.zh: 泥水漫过脚踝，我慢慢挪。
lines.en: Mud water covers my ankles; I shift slowly.

lines.zh: 沼泽里走久了，蹼上全是泥。
lines.en: After a long walk in the swamp, my feet are all mud.

lines.zh: 跟紧我的脚印，别陷进去。
lines.en: Follow my prints and don't sink.

lines.zh: 芦苇一动，我就知道有鱼。
lines.en: When the reeds stir, I know a fish is there.

lines.zh: 芦苇底下一摆尾，我就看见了。
lines.en: A tail flicks under the reeds, and I see it.

lines.zh: 大鞋一样的嘴，敲着芦苇。
lines.en: My shoe-shaped bill knocks the reeds.
The water glare makes me squint.
My long legs sink; I pull one free.

lines.zh: 我站着一动不动，像根木桩。
lines.en: I stand perfectly still, like a wooden post.

lines.zh: 大喙左右摇，是在打量水。
lines.en: My huge beak sways as I study the water.

lines.zh: 眼睛一眨不眨，盯着水面。
lines.en: Unblinking, I stare at the water's surface.
A fish jumped; I did not move.
Wind passes and my feathers lift slightly.
I raise one foot, then set it down.
The swamp is quiet but for insects.

lines.zh: 喉咙里发出轻轻的哒声。
lines.en: A soft clack rises from my throat.

lines.zh: 我缩了缩脖子，藏进羽毛。
lines.en: I pull my neck in and hide in feathers.

lines.zh: 远处鳄鱼翻水，我盯住它。
lines.en: A croc rolls far off; I fix my eyes on it.

lines.zh: 大喙上沾了泥，我甩了甩。
lines.en: Mud on my beak; I give it a shake.

lines.zh: 太阳落进苇丛，光变黄了。
lines.en: The sun sinks into reeds, turning gold.

lines.zh: 我在等一条鱼游到脚边。
lines.en: I am waiting for a fish to reach my feet.
Standing so long, my legs grow stiff.
Standing so long, I blink once.

lines.zh: 第三条鱼游过去了，我没动。
lines.en: The third fish passed, and I didn't move.
Swamp weeds sway slow, just right.

lines.zh: 沼泽里，我一动不动站着。
lines.en: In the swamp I stand perfectly still.
Swamp afternoons are so long.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥里，我一站半天。
lines.en: I stand in the marsh mud half the day.

lines.zh: 水波推我的腿，我像木桩。
lines.en: Ripples push my legs; I'm a post.
Bill open, I wait for a bubble in the mud.
I stand and let the fish come to shore.

lines.zh: 我这大喙一摇，鱼就上来了。
lines.en: One shake of my big bill and the fish is up.

lines.zh: 阳光落在喙上，暖了一块。
lines.en: Sunlight lands on my bill and warms a patch.
Something rustles in the reeds; not a fish.

lines.zh: 吃饱了，我摇摇头告诉你。
lines.en: When I am full, I shake my head to tell you.
A cloud shadow slides across the marsh.
You came closer; I withdraw half a step.
Do not reach out suddenly; I am timid.

lines.zh: 你手里是鱼吗？我看不清。
lines.en: Is that a fish in your hand? I cannot tell.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，是因为你太高。
lines.en: I stare because you are so tall.

lines.zh: 大喙不是用来吓你的，真的。
lines.en: This beak is not meant to scare you, truly.

lines.zh: 你站着不动，我就敢看你。
lines.en: Stand still and I dare look at you.

lines.zh: 沼泽里的东西，我见得多。
lines.en: I have seen many things in this swamp.
Your boots are sinking in the mud.
Do not mock my waddle; my legs are thin.
Step back a bit; then I can relax.

lines.zh: 你手里的光，比水面还亮。
lines.en: The light in your hand outshines the water.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，站了半个钟头。
lines.en: I've stood still for half an hour.

lines.zh: 我的大嘴能夹住整条鱼。
lines.en: My big bill can hold a whole fish.

lines.zh: 我吃饱了，就摇头给你看。
lines.en: When I am full, I shake my head at you.

lines.zh: 你挡住水面，我看不清鱼。
lines.en: You block the water; I can't see the fish.
Don't step there; my fish are underneath.
Shoebill? I'll remember that.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水被我一脚踩浑。
lines.en: One step and the swamp water clouds.

lines.zh: 岸上的草籽，还沾在你裤脚。
lines.en: Grass seeds from the bank still cling to your cuffs.

lines.zh: 你一脚陷进泥里，我看见了。
lines.en: I saw your foot sink into the mud.
Startled, my wings open before I think.
Who is it? I am flying off now.
The wound is light, but I am panicking.
I stagger into the reeds for cover.
Two feathers fell; I mourn them.
Do not chase; I run faster than you.
My beak hit the ground and went numb.

lines.zh: 这声音吓我一跳，谁弄的？
lines.en: That noise startled me; who made it?
I pull my neck in, trying to look small.
The water is safer; I am going in.
You struck my long leg.
I withdraw behind the reeds to recover.
One more knock, and I'll fly off.

lines.zh: 多谢，我这大嘴挡了一下。
lines.en: Thanks, this big beak blocked part of it.
Who knocks at this great bill of mine?
My legs are stuck in the mud.
My big bill has not closed yet.

lines.zh: 羽毛掉了一根，飘在水上。
lines.en: A feather comes loose and floats on the water.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥，蹭脏了我的羽毛。
lines.en: Swamp mud soiled my feathers.
Easy, my bones are thin.
Turtle eggs? I know that smell.
Croc eggs are rank, but I like them.
Set the egg down; do not keep holding it.
I approach slowly; I will not lunge.

lines.zh: 吃了这个，今天运气会好。
lines.en: Eat this and my luck will turn today.

lines.zh: 那条鱼在动，我看得清楚。
lines.en: That fish is wriggling; I see it clearly.
My neck stretches out; I can reach it.
Not yet; let me check my surroundings first.
The shell cracked, and the smell is stronger.
Keep your hand steady; sudden moves scare me.

lines.zh: 我摇头，是吃饱了的意思。
lines.en: When I shake my head, I am full.

lines.zh: 鱼腥味绕着我喙尖打转。
lines.en: Fish smell curls around my bill tip.

lines.zh: 喙先伸出去，脑子才跟上。
lines.en: My bill goes first; my brain catches up.
Swamp fish — just one sniff.
Just one peck, and I won't move.
Is that glint a fish scale?

lines.zh: 你桶里的鱼，尾巴还在拍。
lines.en: The fish in your bucket is still slapping its tail.

lines.zh: 这鱼比水草有滋味多了。
lines.en: This fish tastes far better than weeds.
Is that thing in the mud a lungfish?

lines.zh: 我脖子前倾了，就算承认。
lines.en: My neck leans forward; that's my confession.
You brushed the tip of my wing.
Startled, I back into the reeds.
Do not block the path through the shallows.

lines.zh: 踉跄一下，大喙差点栽进泥。
lines.en: I stumble; my huge beak nearly hits mud.

lines.zh: 踩到你脚边，我是躲虫子。
lines.en: I stepped by your foot to dodge a bug.
My wings opened; that was instinct.
Back off a little; let me catch my breath.
Your steps are heavy; the mud shakes.
I do not bump people; you bumped into me.
Clear a path; I am heading to the far bank.

lines.zh: 我这大嘴一合，泥都溅出来。
lines.en: My big bill claps shut and mud splashes.
Don't bump me; my long legs might snap.

lines.zh: 我这张大嘴差点铲进泥里。
lines.en: My huge bill nearly scooped the mud.

lines.zh: 泥水溅起来，脏了我的羽。
lines.en: Mud splashes up and soils my feathers.
The bubbles pop, and the fish are gone.

lines.zh: 哎，看着点路，我的大嘴很沉。
lines.en: Hey, watch the path; my big bill is heavy.
My feathers are messed up; I'll need ages to fix them.
I know every channel in this swamp.
Go around; my bill is hard.

lines.zh: 我这大嘴，一夹就是一整条鱼。
lines.en: This big bill clamps a whole fish at once.

lines.zh: 你靠这么近，我羽毛都炸了。
lines.en: You are so close my feathers puff up.
I cannot dance; I only sway my beak.
Do not copy my nodding; it flusters me.
A nest... I am truly bad at building one.
My mate is far off; I must return.

lines.zh: 你一直盯着，我怎么放松。
lines.en: With you staring, how can I relax?
The reeds are too short to hide two birds.
I flap twice and step away first.

lines.zh: 沼泽里成了对，就够吵了。
lines.en: A pair in this swamp would be noisy enough.
Do not follow; I walk quickly.

lines.zh: 我叼来一条鱼，放在你脚边。
lines.en: I carry a fish over and lay it at your feet.
My great bill clatters when I call.

lines.zh: 你羽毛上的灰，像沼泽的雾。
lines.en: The grey on your feathers looks like marsh mist.

lines.zh: 芦苇压平了，就是我们的窝。
lines.en: The flattened reeds are our nest.

lines.zh: 这一季我只挑你，大嘴作证。
lines.en: This season I choose only you; my bill swears it.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，等鱼游近。
lines.en: We stand side by side and wait for fish.

lines.zh: 芦苇荡里，我寻你的喙声。
lines.en: In the reeds, I listen for your bill's clatter.

lines.zh: 大嘴碰大嘴，就算定下了。
lines.en: Bill to bill — that settles it.

lines.zh: 沼泽里只剩我们两只大鸟。
lines.en: Only two big birds left in this swamp.

lines.zh: 你梳理羽毛，我站着看呆了。
lines.en: You preen, and I stand transfixed.
This egg is mine to carry off.
A dead fish on the bank; convenient.
One clamp of my beak snaps the weeds.
I peck snails out of the mud.
I will not eat this; I set it down.

lines.zh: 叼着蛋不好走路，慢慢来。
lines.en: Carrying an egg makes walking hard; slowly.
Something fell in the water; I fish it out.
My beak is stuffed; I cannot swallow.
This shell is still warm.
I will set it back beside the nest.
This shell is too hard; I just shake it.

lines.zh: 我的喙大得能夹住整条鱼。
lines.en: My bill can hold a whole fish.
I'll carry this fish to the reeds.
One swamp fish per bite.

lines.zh: 吃饱了我就摇头，别喂了。
lines.en: When I'm full I shake my head — stop feeding me.
Whatever I dig out of the mud is mine.
This bright scrap goes at the nest edge.
I pick it up and stash it in the reeds.
When I'm full, I shake my head.
Bury it in the mud; I'll find it next year.
That fish in the water is my mark.
Something is moving in the mud.
The young croc is small, just right.
The little turtle is slow; it cannot flee.
I lower my neck and creep closer.
A ring spreads on the water, right there.

lines.zh: 它探出头，我等它再近些。
lines.en: It pokes its head out; I wait for more.
A loach hides in its burrow by my foot.
This strike must be quick, or I miss.
It is not watching me; perfect.

lines.zh: 我这双大脚，踩得沼泥直响。
lines.en: These big feet make the marsh squelch.
The moment you lift a foot, I'm on you.
My neck shoots out; no count needed.
Bubbles in the mud; a big one.

lines.zh: 沼泽里站着，我一动不动。
lines.en: Standing in the marsh, I don't move a feather.
Miss once, and the fish is gone.

lines.zh: 沼泽里，我的大嘴已经张开。
lines.en: In the swamp, my great bill already open.

lines.zh: 沼泽里的鱼，正往这边游。
lines.en: The swamp fish are drifting this way.
That loach has stopped by the weeds.
The fish flicks its tail, and my bill falls.
I stand motionless and let it relax.
My beak is aimed; one step remains.
Light shifts on the water; do not get distracted.
A moment more and it will come out.
The mud is cloudy; I cannot see my feet.
Keep the wings still; movement gives me away.
It is swimming toward the reeds on the left.
I edge forward half a step, only half.

lines.zh: 脖子绷紧，随时能弹出去。
lines.en: My neck is taut, ready to snap forward.
I cannot let this tension drop.
I can stand here until your legs ache.
No reeds are thick enough to hide you.
Your footsteps in the sand are too loud.

lines.zh: 你绕到哪，我的喙就朝哪。
lines.en: Wherever you circle, my bill follows.
Until a fish comes close, I won't move.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，等你踩进泥里。
lines.en: I stand still and wait for you to step in the mud.
Only I may stand in this shallows.

lines.zh: 沼泽的浅水，正是我站的地方。
lines.en: The shallows of the swamp are where I stand.

lines.zh: 沼泽里我一动不动，像块木头。
lines.en: In the marsh I stand still as wood.

lines.zh: 你踩水的声响，传得很远。
lines.en: Your splashing carries a long way.
My great beak slams down; the water bursts.
Caught; it cannot twist free.
I whip my head and fling it onto the mud.
This peck is too fast to follow.
My wings spread to keep my footing.
It snapped at my leg; I hopped away.
One more strike before it rolls over.
My beak stabs the mud and comes up full.
The scuffle startles a flock of egrets.
Even winning, I inspect before eating.

lines.zh: 沼泽的浅水，我站着做主。
lines.en: In the marsh shallows, I stand in charge.
This big bill holds fish tight.
My bill sweeps, flattening the reeds.
Don't struggle in my bill; you'll drop.

lines.zh: 这口咬给抢我鱼的家伙。
lines.en: This bite is for the one who stole my fish.
My bill snaps, and mud sprays.

lines.zh: 我这嘴一合，声音像木板。
lines.en: When my bill snaps shut, it sounds like boards.
That one used half my bill's strength.

lines.zh: 我这张大嘴，一口能夹住鱼。
lines.en: This big bill can hold a whole fish.
Three steps from the nest, and I peck.
I walk out of the reeds.
I land on the shallows; mud covers my feet.
Wings folded, I survey my surroundings.
This swamp is shallow and full of fish.
I shake the water from my feathers.

lines.zh: 大喙在晨雾里显得更大。
lines.en: In the morning mist my beak looks even bigger.

lines.zh: 远处有鳄鱼叫，我得小心。
lines.en: A croc calls far off; I must be careful.
I find a fallen log for a good view.
No one is here; perfect for fishing.
I come down and mud splashes everywhere.

lines.zh: 我这只大嘴，专敲沼泽的泥。
lines.en: This great bill is for knocking the swamp mud.
Beyond the reeds, a fish jumps.
A new marsh, and the mud smells strange.

lines.zh: 沼泽这么浅，我站得很高。
lines.en: The marsh is shallow. I stand tall.
When I am full, I shake my head.

lines.zh: 先找块沼泽的芦苇躲一下。
lines.en: Let me hide in the swamp reeds first.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水刚好没过脚踝。
lines.en: The swamp water just covers my ankles.
The reeds are thick; I squeeze through.
Full now. I shake my head.

lines.zh: 沼泽里站着不动，才是我的风格。
lines.en: Standing still in the swamp is my style.
Feathers curl at a touch of flame; I flee.
My big bill got scorched — that hurts.

lines.zh: 摔下来时，我把翅膀撑开。
lines.en: As I fell, I spread my wings wide.
I fall into the mud, bill first.

lines.zh: 水灌进喙里，我呛得乱蹬。
lines.en: Water pours into my beak; I kick wildly.
Water covers my bill; I jerk my head up.

lines.zh: 响声太大，我整只鸟都僵了。
lines.en: The blast is so loud my whole body freezes.

lines.zh: 爆响过后，我耳朵还在鸣。
lines.en: After the blast, my ears still ring.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在我脚边的泥里。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in the mud beside my feet.

lines.zh: 箭扎进翅膀，我歪了一下。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my wing; I tilt.

lines.zh: 我看不清了，眼前都是光。
lines.en: I cannot see; light fills my eyes.

lines.zh: 谁的咒语，让我的喙发麻？
lines.en: Whose spell is numbing my bill?

lines.zh: 饿得我连泥里的螺都翻。
lines.en: So hungry I dig snails out of the mud.

lines.zh: 沼泽里站太久，腿都僵了。
lines.en: Standing so long in the marsh, my legs stiffen.

lines.zh: 雷劈在苇丛，我吓得伏低。
lines.en: Lightning hits the reeds; I flatten in fear.

lines.zh: 雷落在水面，我羽毛全炸。
lines.en: Lightning hits the water; every feather bristles.
No mud beneath me, and no water either.
The marsh dried; time to move nests.
